# TextArea

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTextArea` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTextArea.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTextArea.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTextArea.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Multi-line text or code

## Overview

Text area control with integrated syntax highlighting and full UTF-8 support

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTextAreaExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextAreaExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasRichTextEdit](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.md)
- [UltraCanvasTextInputExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextInputExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasMediaViewer](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMediaViewer.md)
- [UltraCanvasSmoothScroll](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSmoothScroll.md)
- [UltraCanvasLaTeXDocumentReader](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasLaTeXDocumentReader.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTextArea(const std::string& name, float x, float y, float width, float height);
UltraCanvasTextArea(const std::string& name, float width, float height);
explicit UltraCanvasTextArea(const std::string& name);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### struct `CpRun`

Maps one contiguous visible-text segment back to its source-line position. Each entry: at visible codepoint `visibleCp`, the source-line codepoint is `sourceCp`. Inside a segment both indices advance in lockstep; a new entry starts after `sourceCp` jumps over a stripped block prefix or inline-markup run. The vector is sorted strictly ascending on `visibleCp`, has at least one entry `{0, blockPrefixCp}`, and ends with a sentinel `{visibleCpCount, sourceCpCount}` so range queries need no special-case for the last segment.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `visibleCp` | `int visibleCp = 0` |  |
| `sourceCp` | `int sourceCp = 0` |  |

### struct `MathBlockLayout`

Display-math block: `$$` on a line of its own opens it, the next such line closes it. The opening fence and the source lines collapse to zero height in rendered form (with the caret anywhere in the block, all its lines show raw - see rawBlockLines); the closing fence renders the whole formula, centred, from the source gathered off the collapsed lines.

|---|---|---|
| `source` | `std::string source` | a collapsed source line's text |

| `mathWidth` | `float mathWidth = 0.f` |  |
